senses.gloss:
श्लोक् श्लोक् (probably rather a Nom. fr.
श्लोक below), cl. 1. A. श्लोकते, श्लोकि-
तुम्, to versify, compose or make verses, hymn or
praise in verse; to be put together or composed; to
acquire; to relinquish, abandon.

श्लोक, अस्, m. (probably connected with rt. 1.
श्रु; according to Rāmāyaṇa I. 2, 33. fr. शोक,
‘sorrow,’ the first Śloka having resulted from the
involuntary expression of Vālmīki's grief at be-
holding a bird killed by a fowler), praising or
hymning in verse, a hymn of praise; an object of
praise; celebrity, renown, fame, reputation; a par-
ticular kind of common epic metre (also called Anu-
ṣṭubh, consisting of four Pādas or quarter verses of
eight syllables each, or two lines of sixteen syllables
each; the following is the usual scheme applicable
[]
to both lines ....˘˘˘. | ....˘¯˘. , the
mark. denoting either long or short, and the sixth
syllable being either short or long, but if short, then
requiring the seventh to be short also, and if long,
then long); any verse or stanza; a proverb, saying;
= वाच् (Naigh. I. 11).
—श्लोक-ता, f. or श्लोक-त्व,
अम्, n. versification; celebrity in verse.
—श्लोक-
द्वय, अम्, n. a couple of Ślokas, two verses.
—श्लोक-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, composed in Ślokas.
—श्लोक-मात्र, अम्, n. a single Śloka.

श्लोकय, Nom. P. श्लोकयति, -यितुम्, to celebrate
in song.

श्लोकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. having hymns of praise,
receiving praise, praised, lauded.

श्लोक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in hymns of praise, be-
longing to Ślokas.

श्लोण् श्लोण् (also written श्रोण्), cl. 1. P.
श्लोणति, श्लोणितुम्, to accumulate, col-
lect, assemble, heap together: Caus. श्लोणयति, -यि-
तुम्, Aor. अशुश्लोणत्.

श्लोण श्लोण, अस्, m. (= श्रोण; cf. अ-श्लोण),
a lame man, cripple.
